text: I had the most wonderful experience getting my nails done by Rosie! She is incredibly talented and pays such close attention to detail. From the moment I sat down, she made sure I was comfortable and listened carefully to what I wanted. The design she created was exactly what I had in mind, and her precision in shaping and painting my nails was flawless. The whole process was relaxing, and she used high-quality products that made my nails look and feel amazing. I’ve received so many compliments, and I’ll definitely be going back to Rosie for my next appointment. Highly recommend her services if you’re looking for beautiful, long-lasting nails!

The acrylic set that Rosie did for me were so pretty. I gave her an inspo picture and the nails exceeded my expectations. She took her time and was very attentive to the nail shape and design. I couldn’t be happier with how my nails turned out! The staff were very welcoming, and I also enjoyed a pedicure; the full-seevice experience was great. I’ll definitely be returning!

Best nail salon I have ever been too! Had the best experience with Rosie. She is extremely talented and efficient. I got a shellac refill and it only took an hour. I booked online and the manager Tommy greeted me when I arrived, and sat and chatted. Super down to earth and friendly. I will definitely be back!

Booked my girlfriend here for the first time and when we walked in the place looked amazing! Didn’t know who to go to so they just booked us under Rosie and she did an amazing job. My girlfriend then decided to get a pedicure as well and the staff were so friendly and treated her right away! New manager is a sweetheart and always made sure everyone was happy. Safe to say the girlfriend was also happy!

Decided to treat myself to a pedicure and manicure since it has been a bit difficult maintaining my nails in the third trimester by myself. I was recommended to check out this salon, so I took my mom with me to do our nails. Although I felt self conscious to do this in the first place, I ended up really enjoying it. They did an excellent job (honestly better than I would ever do) and it was fun to choose a polish. The whole staff were pleasant and very accommodating. My nail tech was thorough and gentle which made the whole experience very relaxing.  My mom also loved her shellac pedicure and now both of us are hooked.  Highly recommend this salon and would be coming back to get our nails done here from now on.
